mappings.rationale: The controlled Transformers node is narrower than NACE Rev. 2.1 class 27.11, which includes manufacture of electric motors, generators and transformers.
CPA 2.2 group 27.11.4 is the electrical-transformer product family and is the closest official product-family target for the controlled Transformers node.

mappings.label: Manufacture of electric motors, generators, transformers and electricity distribution and control apparatus
mappings.rationale: ISIC Rev. 5 class 2710 explicitly includes manufacture of power, distribution and specialty transformers; it is broader than the controlled Transformers node.

mappings.label: Power, Distribution, and Specialty Transformer Manufacturing
mappings.rationale: NAICS 2022 U.S. industry 335311 directly describes manufacturing power, distribution and specialty transformers, making it a tighter activity match than the broader NACE and ISIC classes.
Switchgear is included within NACE Rev. 2.1 class 27.12 Manufacture of electricity distribution and control apparatus.

mappings.label: Manufacture of electric motors, generators, transformers and electricity distribution and control apparatus
mappings.rationale: ISIC Rev. 5 class 2710 includes switchgear and distribution/control apparatus, so the international classification is coarser than the NACE split between 27.11 and 27.12.

mappings.label: Switchgear and Switchboard Apparatus Manufacturing
mappings.rationale: NAICS 2022 U.S. industry 335313 directly describes switchgear and switchboard apparatus manufacturing.
Power cables fall within the broader NACE Rev. 2.1 class 27.32 Manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables.

mappings.label: Manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables
mappings.rationale: ISIC Rev. 5 class 2732 covers other electronic and electric wires and cables and is broader than the controlled Power cables node.

mappings.label: Other Communication and Energy Wire Manufacturing
mappings.rationale: NAICS 2022 U.S. industry 335929 covers insulated nonferrous communication and energy wire/cable manufacturing and is broader than the controlled Power cables node.
The controlled High-voltage power cables node is materially narrower than NACE Rev. 2.1 class 27.32; voltage detail is lost at this activity-classification level.

mappings.label: Manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables
mappings.rationale: ISIC Rev. 5 class 2732 does not preserve high-voltage detail, demonstrating expected information loss when translating the controlled node to a coarser convention.

mappings.label: Other Communication and Energy Wire Manufacturing
mappings.rationale: NAICS 2022 code 335929 does not preserve high-voltage detail, so the translation intentionally records information loss.
The controlled Submarine power cables node is narrower than NACE Rev. 2.1 class 27.32; installation environment is not preserved by this activity code.

mappings.label: Manufacture of other electronic and electric wires and cables
mappings.rationale: ISIC Rev. 5 class 2732 does not preserve submarine/offshore detail; this is intentionally exposed as a coarser translation rather than treated as exact equivalence.

mappings.label: Other Communication and Energy Wire Manufacturing
mappings.rationale: NAICS 2022 code 335929 does not preserve submarine/offshore installation detail, so the translation intentionally records information loss.
